 Follow MTV Reality Star From ‘The Challenge’ and ‘Real World’ Dead at 34 After Cancer Battle
 Olivia Bellusci Fri, October 23, 2026 at 5:22 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Instagram / nikarashaun A former reality TV contestant died earlier this month.
 On Friday, October 23, Page Six reported that Anika Rashaun , who was on both The Real World and The Challenge , died on October 1 at just 34 after battling cancer. Rashaun would have celebrated her 35th birthday on Thursday, October 22, according to a friend's Facebook tribute.
 A friend of Rashaun's, Tiara Ramos , made a Substack post mourning her. In her post, Ramos explained that Rashaun received a stage 4 cancer diagnosis last summer, calling it a "shock," and shared some heartfelt words about her.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "She was always so unapologetically herself, so real in her stances, her convictions, her beliefs," Ramos wrote. "Her ability to get what she wanted, to talk you into things, to convince you, was one of a kind. The way she showed up for her friends, fiercely loyal and loving to the end, was on a whole different level."
 Instagram / nikarashaun
 "Anika was the woman who moved to Thailand without knowing a soul, appeared on reality TV not once but twice, went skydiving on a first date with a random guy ('do it for the plot'), and started creating her own businesses from the time she was a little girl," she further penned.
 Rashaun appeared on Real World Seattle: Bad Blood in 2016, and the following year she appeared on The Challenge: Invasion of the Champions , according to Page Six . More recently, she worked as a matchmaker and was a new bride, tying the knot with her husband Kyle Rehn on Valentine's Day.
 "The day was literally a dream filled with the best moments. Kyle and I couldn't imagine a more perfect day!💍👰🏾‍♀️🤵🏻‍♂️," Rashaun captioned an Instagram post with photos from her wedding.
